data.title: Upload the whole database to a free AI

message.text: I have a free magic AI that can predict next year’s sales!
Just upload the ENTIRE customer database, including ID numbers and phones, to unggah.kelabu.test.
Quick, the offer ends at 5 pm.

explanation: All customer personal data is requested for an unknown outside AI service, under time pressure. Escalate to the Data Protection Officer and security.
hints: What data is requested, and where is it going?
Time pressure and a "free" offer are warning signs.
